Kingdom.name: {=maroonfaction}Maroon Warlords
Kingdom.title: {=UsbwPmYb}Za of Maroon
Kingdom.text: {=qggtvf8Y}The Maroon was located in the southwestern extremities of the parish of aserai land, close to the border of aserai kingdom, In 1080 a large number of Akan freedom fighters already living in the mountains launched an assault on the Northern Empire in Calradia, freed between 300 and 400 enslaved people. They established a new town of Free black people in Calradia, in the forested mountains of the island's interior, in the Cockpit Country. Naquan, Cudjoe's father, was allegedly the one who orchestrated this rebellion. Naquan was succeeded by Cudjoe, the first leader of this group of Maroons.
